rca of the issue: Root cause of iteration_2 bug was React 18 StrictMode double-invoking the auto-start useEffect. Both invocations of run() reset logCounter.current=0 and pushed logs in parallel, colliding on ids like 'log-1', 'log-2', 'log-3'. Iteration_3 mitigation is two-layer: (1) synchronous ref-based lock `runningRef.current` set at the top of run() so the 2nd invocation early-returns before touching counter/log state; (2) log id now includes Date.now() timestamp so even if the lock were somehow bypassed, ids remain unique. Verified via 2 full flows with browser console capture — 0 duplicate-key warnings.
